title: Object Storage: discount priority
content:
Object Storage discount priority is defined as follows: Non-stacking selection order for primary-usage price; string list.

| Contract tier | Discount priority |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | discount priority: negotiated; reservation; promotion; portfolio; standard |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | discount priority: negotiated; reservation; promotion; portfolio; standard |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | discount priority: negotiated; reservation; promotion; portfolio; standard |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | discount priority: negotiated; reservation; promotion; portfolio; standard |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | discount priority: negotiated; reservation; promotion; portfolio; standard |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | discount priority: negotiated; reservation; promotion; portfolio; standard |

## Selection order

The listed priority runs from negotiated pricing through reservation, promotion and portfolio pricing to standard pricing.
